npmCommand: [ "$1" = install ] || { echo '"1.0.0"'; exit 0; }; prefix=; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case $1 in --prefix) prefix=$2; shift 2;; *) shift;; esac; done; echo "npm warn deprecated left-pad@1.0.0: use something else"; d=$prefix/node_modules/probe-npm; mkdir -p $d/prompts; printf '{"name":"probe-npm","version":"1.0.0","pi":{"prompts":["prompts"]}}' > $d/package.json; printf 'hello\n' > $d/prompts/probenpm.md; echo "added 1 package in 1s"
